title: Raw-active p90 mapped-HWA and seven-level QAT learning-rate screen
hypothesis: At least one predeclared multiplier in {0.25,1,4} around each matched RESET-relative layerwise schedule will improve apparent programmed validation accuracy after three partial epochs over the corresponding zero-update raw-active mapper without numerical failure.
motivation: The raw-active protocol changes the model coordinate, array baseline, differential budget, forward gains, and mapped operating point, so the RESET-relative learning rates are used only as screen centers. A read-only replay on the same 1,024-example validation cohort measured the clean, continuous-mapped, and seven-level-mapped gradient distributions without an optimizer step. This prerequisite screen freezes one rate pair per HWA mode before the full ten-epoch matched study. It does not access the test split or held-out assignment.

arms.description: Continuous mapped-target HWA at 0.25 times the inherited RESET-relative continuous schedule.
Continuous mapped-target HWA at the inherited RESET-relative continuous schedule.
Continuous mapped-target HWA at four times the inherited RESET-relative continuous schedule.
Seven-level mapped-target QAT at 0.25 times the inherited RESET-relative QAT schedule.
Seven-level mapped-target QAT at the inherited RESET-relative QAT schedule.
Seven-level mapped-target QAT at four times the inherited RESET-relative QAT schedule.

completion_criteria: Before launch, verify zero-update raw-active checkpoint SHA-256 97785347e39bfaf14026dc06bf8b28a7e0e30711543e7a566baf915022c860d5, teacher SHA-256 9a961a77628e365b54fdf59304ec7fddf46f1f4834c4c03cecea9c204f837f52, device-model SHA-256 3030e04d6205dc90d0894ac453d2c1c522dffdc004f69b9c6ab7eaf7ef4b8ba3, development population fingerprint 4887ad89abdd16193448c54a0cbe97be915cb4b9bc04cf1151c5e2a96ee5a3ac, and gradient-replay SHA-256 a13885ace607269a05cb21ad7fbafec203012c3fcd6102efcfb68d92f32db32f.

All six arms use runtime/data seed 42, CPU float32, batch size 16, the identical zero-update checkpoint, assignment seed 84001, mapping-only training endpoint seed 84002, pulse-resolved selection endpoint seed 84003, the same layouts and structural-failure policy, and exactly one apparent selection repeat.

Every arm completes exactly three epochs of exactly 1,024 training minibatches per epoch and evaluates exactly 128 validation minibatches at initialization and each epoch. No test example, held-out assignment, extra multiplier, or adaptive rate change is allowed.

Mapped training uses the exact raw-active mapper on eligible quads and the transformed RESET bound on declared structural failures; it does not pretend to simulate pulse noise. Selection uses boundary-conditioned independent-device one-pulse P&V with the 128-pulse target budget and preserves unclipped apparent endpoints.

Freeze one rate pair per mode by highest selected apparent programmed validation accuracy. Break an exact accuracy tie by lower apparent KL, then smaller multiplier. Record the selected checkpoint/run hashes before creating the full-study configs.
Preserve every failed or partial attempt. Operational recovery may fix code defects and rerun a config, but may not change rates, epochs, cohorts, gains, mapping, or selection rules.
analysis_plan: For each mode, tabulate each multiplier's selected epoch, selected apparent validation accuracy, apparent KL and teacher agreement, terminal metrics, clean logical validation metrics, mapping counts, and bound occupancy.

Report learning-rate-scaled proposed update RMS at initialization using the frozen read-only replay, explicitly separating raw gradients from scaled updates and noting that clean and mapped states have different operating points.

Select continuous and seven-level winners independently using only the declared apparent validation rule. This screen does not compare the two modes scientifically and does not establish a need for on-chip training.
Carry only the frozen winner rates into the ten-epoch study; do not tune on physical held-out deployment outcomes.
